name: XXXG-01W Wing Gundam
lore: The classic Earth-bound transforming mobile suit designed by Dr. J. Capable of transforming into Bird Mode.
armament: Buster Rifle, Beam Sabers, Machine Cannons, Shield with Beam Saber.

name: XXXG-01W Wing Gundam Zero (EW)
lore: Iconic angel-winged mobile suit featuring twin buster rifles and Zero System psychological combat interface.
armament: Twin Buster Rifle, Machine Cannons, Wing Binder Shield.

name: XXXG-01D Gundam Deathscythe (EW)
lore: Stealth-oriented close-combat mobile suit equipped with hyper jammer jammers and active camouflage.
armament: Beam Scythe, Buster Shield, Vulcan Guns.

name: XXXG-01H Gundam Heavyarms (EW)
lore: Walking armory packed with vulcan guns, missile pods, and chest gatling guns for overwhelming barrage firepower.
armament: Chest Gatling Guns, Beam Gatling, Homing Missiles, Army Knife.

name: XXXG-01S Gundam Sandrock (EW)
lore: Command-type mobile suit designed for desert combat and melee skirmishes, featuring heat shotels.
armament: Heat Shotels, Shield, Beam Machine Gun.

name: XXXG-01SR Gundam Shenlong (EW)
lore: Martial arts inspired mobile suit featuring an extendable dragon fang arm and beam glaive.
armament: Dragon Fang, Beam Glaive, Vulcans, Shenlong Shield.

name: OZ-00MS Tallgeese I
lore: The grandfather of all modern mobile suits, featuring extreme thruster output that tests the limits of human G-forces.
armament: Dober Gun, Beam Saber, Shield.

name: OZ-00MS2 Tallgeese II
lore: Upgraded commander unit piloted by Treize Khushrenada featuring distinctive crest and refined thrust vectoring.
armament: Dober Gun, Beam Saber, Shield.

name: OZ-13MS Gundam Epyon (EW)
lore: Ultimate melee combat suit built without firearms, integrating the Zero System and dragon transformation mode.
armament: Beam Sword (direct energy cable), Heat Rod, Mega Cannon (Dragon mode).

name: XXXG-00W0 Wing Gundam Zero
lore: The original TV animation design of Wing Zero with conventional flight binder wings and twin buster rifle.
armament: Twin Buster Rifle, Wing Vulcans, Beam Saber.

name: XXXG-01S2 Altron Gundam
lore: Upgraded version of Shenlong featuring twin dragon arms and twin beam trident.
armament: Twin Dragon Hangs, Twin Beam Trident, Dragon Cannons.

name: XXXG-01H2 Gundam Heavyarms Custom (EW)
lore: Final combat phase featuring double twin beam gatlings and clown mask for psychological warfare.
armament: Double Beam Gatlings, Full Body Missile Pods.

name: XXXG-01D2 Gundam Deathscythe Hell (EW)
lore: Equipped with active cloaking wing binders that resemble bat wings in defense mode.
armament: Twin Beam Scythe, Buster Shield with Beam Blade.

name: XXXG-01SR2 Gundam Sandrock Custom (EW)
lore: Customized desert mobile suit equipped with heavy thermal cloak mantle for stealth desert deployment.
armament: Heat Shotels, Thermal Cloak Mantle.

name: OZ-00MS Tallgeese III
lore: Ultimate upgrade commissioned by the Preventers, armed with the devastating Mega Cannon.
armament: Mega Cannon, Heat Rod, Vulcans, Shield.

name: MMS-01 Serpent (EW)
lore: Mass-produced heavy artillery mobile suit deployed by Barton Foundation forces during the rebellion.
armament: Double Gatling Gun, Missile Launchers, Bazooka.

name: OZ-06MS Leo
lore: Ubiquitous mass-production mobile suit utilized by all major factions throughout the After Colony era.
armament: 105mm Rifle, Beam Saber, Shield, Bazooka.

name: OZ-06MS Leo (Space Type)
lore: Modified Leo variant equipped with backpack thrusters and high-mobility propellant tanks for space combat.
armament: Beam Rifle, Space Thruster Pack, Shield.

name: XXXG-01W Wing Gundam Proto Zero (EW)
lore: Prototype design bridging the TV Wing Zero and the Endless Waltz angelic iteration.
armament: Twin Buster Rifle, Beam Sabers, Shield.

name: XXXG-01H Gundam Heavyarms (Igel Unit)
lore: Equipped with additional missile pods and tracked caterpillar treads on legs for ultimate siege warfare.
armament: Igel Missile Units, Leg Tracks, Gatling Guns.

name: XXXG-01S Gundam Sandrock (Armadillo Unit)
lore: Heavy armor booster equipment package designed to protect Sandrock during orbital re-entry and close combat.
armament: Armadillo Armor Plates, Heat Shotels.

name: XXXG-01SR Gundam Shenlong (Liao Unit)
lore: Special color variation and customized equipment suite celebrating traditional Chinese mecha motifs.
armament: Extended Dragon Fang, Beam Glaive.

name: OZ-00MS Tallgeese Flugel
lore: Intermediate Tallgeese prototype fitted with prototype proto-zero winged binders.
armament: Dober Gun, Flugel Wings, Heat Saber.

name: OZ-13MS Gundam Epyon (Special Coating)
lore: Collector edition featuring metallic extra-finish red and gold electroplated armor plating.
armament: Beam Sword, Heat Rod, Mega Cannon.

name: XXXG-01W Wing Gundam Zero (Clear Color)
lore: Exhibition limited clear-armor edition showcasing internal mechanical frame details.
armament: Twin Buster Rifle, Angel Wings.

name: MMS-01 Serpent (Custom Commander)
lore: Commander variant of the Serpent mass-production mobile suit with enhanced communications array.
armament: Double Gatling, Heavy Missile Pods.

name: OZ-06MS Leo (Flight Unit Option Set)
lore: Leo unit bundled with atmospheric jet flight packs for aerial supremacy.
armament: Flight Pack, 105mm Rifle, Beam Saber.

name: XXXG-01D Gundam Deathscythe (Hell Custom Colors)
lore: Special rollout color scheme inspired by early concept sketches of the Gundam Deathscythe.
armament: Beam Scythe, Buster Shield.

name: OZ-00MS2 Tallgeese II (Special Coating)
lore: Luxurious metallic gloss injection coating highlighting the royal blue and white aesthetic.
armament: Dober Gun, Shield, Beam Saber.

name: XXXG-01W Wing Gundam (Early Type Ver.Ka)
lore: Katoki Hajime redesigned version of the original Wing Gundam with refined proportions and waterslide decals.
armament: Buster Rifle, Shield, Beam Sabers.
